[issue by GameBurrow]
**Describe the bug**
Server crashes when moving around the world around areas that have electricity setups. 

Not sure if the cause is Create: New Age or Create Crafts & Additions, but it looks like issue is both of them together.

**To Reproduce**
N/A

Yeah not sure what causes this

[comment by GameBurrow (none)]
I did some asking around with players, the only craft&additions items they had in their electricity network is the battery, so that must be the item that is crashing.

One of the more technically knowledgebale players threw around the idea that the electricity network was trying to pull more from the battery than it can handle and that caused it. No idea if that can be the case or not.
